title: New Random Features
description: Adds many new random features to the game
body:
# Welcome to "New Random Features"!

This mod adds many random, funny, or usefull features into the game.

## Including:

- A new ore that has doors, stairs, slabs, buttons, pressure plates, fences, walls and so on
- A new food: Strawberries
- A new fuel: Pine Cones

### Note:

_And more soon_
